 Kings Announce Injury Updates On Murray, Raynaud, Cardwell
 By Rory Maher |
 at October 26, 2026 6:55 pm 
 Kings forward Keegan Murray will be reevaluated in 10-to-14 days after being diagnosed with left ankle capsulitis , the team announced in a press release .
 Murray experienced soreness and stiffness in his surgically repaired left ankle after the team’s loss to Portland on Friday. He was ruled out of Sunday’s loss to Memphis after initially being listed as questionable.
 The Kings also provided injury updates on second-year centers Maxime Raynaud (right patellar subluxation) and Dylan Cardwell (left calf strain).
 According to the team, Raynaud is progressing well in his rehabilitation from his right knee injury and will be checked out again in about two weeks. Cardwell could be a little closer to returning, as he’ll be reexamined in approximately seven days.
 Raynaud suffered his injury in a preseason game vs. Golden State on Oct. 10. Cardwell was hurt two days prior, in an Oct. 8 loss at the Lakers.
 De’Andre Hunter , Precious Achiuwa and Jonathan Mogbo are among the Kings who could get more playing time with Murray, Raynaud and Cardwell out.
